A Birthday Special

for someone very special to Amit 💗

Eight little things to do, and with each one a little more of your gift opens. Take your time, it’s made to be enjoyed slowly. 🎶

First, the key: enter the date that is all yours.

1 · Light the candle 🕯️

Press and hold the match until the wick glows.

🕯️

2 · Catch the hearts 💗

Eight of them are floating up for you. Tap to catch. 0 / 8

3 · What happens next? ✉️

Open all three envelopes to find out.

4 · Draw your star 🌟

Tap the stars in order, 1 to 8, and see what the sky spells out.

5 · Make a wish 🏮

Whisper one wish just for yourself. It stays with you, nothing is saved.

6 · Match the memories 🧩

Flip the cards and find all five matching pairs.

7 · The Wish Genie 🧞‍♀️

Tap a wish, then hold to receive it. Open at least 3 to continue, or all eight 🌟

8 · Open when… 💌

Six little letters for six kinds of moments. Open them all.

Everything is open 🤍

Happy Birthday, Gayatri.

Four little gifts, tap each one 🎁

Dear Gayatri,

Today is yours, so today the world should be a little softer and a little kinder. 🌷 You deserve that, and so much more.

I hope this year gives you more love than your heart can hold, from people who show it and never make you wonder. I hope you are hugged often and understood without having to explain.

I hope you find more courage too. You have always been stronger than you think. On the heavy days, remember that you have gotten through every hard day so far, and you will get through the next one with that same quiet strength. 🦋

And honestly, I miss you. Quietly, warmly, and without any expectation. You will always have a soft corner in my heart. There is nothing to answer and nothing to fix. I just wanted you to know that you are cherished. 🤍

You have always been someone special to me. The moments we spent together live in my memories, and they will always be there. You were the first one to ever be that close to me, and that is something nothing can change. 🤍

Wishing you laughter, health, peace, and every dream you have whispered to the stars. ✨

Always rooting for you, 💖
Amit

Made with love, from your person who cares about you, even without talking to you, even without being connected to you. 🤍

Happy Birthday, Gayatri ✨
